reference.criterion: Routine calls offer three-dimensional physical-presence realism using the specified direct-eye or holographic display systems.
reference.rationale: Ordinary 2019 video calls did not deliver the asserted 3D physical-presence experience and acuity. Google Beam/HP Dimension demonstrates a serious enterprise 3D telepresence direction, but not routine consumer calls or proven above-human acuity.
